description.value: Hi5 Pizza and Donair is a neighbourhood fast-food shop on East Hastings Street in Vancouver specializing in pizza and donairs, making their dough in-house daily and using house-made sauce from local tomatoes. Cyclists passing through the area can order online for quick counter pickup via SkipTheDishes, UberEats, or DoorDash, or call ahead to skip the line.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms an active pizza/donair takeout shop at 2411 E Hastings St with online ordering for pickup; the phone number matches OSM exactly. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-relevant amenities appears anywhere on the site. A postal code discrepancy exists: OSM has V5K 1Z2 while the website consistently shows V5K 1Y8.
